name: SalfaCorp S.A.
summary: SalfaCorp S.A. engages in engineering, construction, and real estate businesses in Chile and internationally. The company offers construction and industrial assembly, civil works construction, industrial maintenance, installation of equipment, mining development, marine works, earthmoving, and drilling and blasting services, as well as undertakes engineering, procurement, and construction projects. The company also involved in real estate, commercial, and infrastructure activities; and development and rental of commercial and industrial projects. The company was founded in 1929 and is based in Santiago, Chile.
